slides.title: What actually works
items: Check resale too: the exact piece often turns up there first
Search other stores that carry the brand, not just the brand's site
Note your size *and* the size system (EU 44, US 10, 32×30)
Set an alert for your size only, so you're not pinged for sizes you can't wear

posts.title: 5 signs that 'deal' site is a scam

slides.sub: Before you check out, check these.

slides.title: Red flags
items: The web address is one letter off from the real brand
Every single item is marked down absurdly far
No returns policy, no street address, no real contact
Payment only by wire, Zelle, gift card or crypto
The photos are the brand's own, but the site isn't

slides.label: Quick check
slides.title: Reverse-search one product photo. If it's on the brand's site, buy it *there*.
